### Q2. Which mechanism contributes to increased venous thromboembolism risk during prolonged immobility?

Source bank Q1.

- **A.** Reduced blood viscosity in every case
- **B.** Reduced skeletal muscle pumping and venous stasis
- **C.** Complete elimination of coagulation factors
- **D.** Increased venous return from constant walking

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: B. Reduced skeletal muscle pumping and venous stasis**

**A kyun galat hai:** Blood viscosity blood ke flow ki resistance se related hai. Immobility har patient mein viscosity kam nahi karti aur clot ka risk khatam nahi hota.

**B kyun sahi hai:** Jab hum chalte hain, toh leg muscles contract hokar veins ka blood heart ki taraf bhejti hain. Bed rest mein ye muscle pump kam active hota hai. Blood dheere flow karta hai, jise venous stasis kehte hain. Isse deep vein thrombosis ka risk badhta hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Bed rest se clotting factors khatam nahi hote. Clot banne ki tendency aur venous flow dono patient ke risk factors par depend karte hain.

**D kyun galat hai:** Walking muscle pump ko active karti hai aur venous return support karti hai. Yeh prolonged immobility ka mechanism nahi hai.

**Exam clue:** Virchow triad mein immobility ko venous stasis se jodo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q8. Why can prolonged immobilization increase the risk of a joint contracture?

Source bank Q4.

- **A.** Cartilage becomes an actively contracting muscle
- **B.** Muscles and connective tissues can shorten when joints remain in one position
- **C.** All ligaments disappear immediately
- **D.** Joint mobility increases without limit

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: B. Muscles and connective tissues can shorten when joints remain in one position**

**A kyun galat hai:** Cartilage joint surfaces ko cushion karta hai. Yeh actively contracting muscle mein convert nahi hota.

**B kyun sahi hai:** Jab joint bahut samay tak ek position mein rehta hai, toh muscle aur connective tissue shorten aur stiff ho sakte hain. Persistent movement limitation ko contracture kehte hain. Suitable positioning aur prescribed range-of-motion exercises risk kam karne mein madad karti hain.

**C kyun galat hai:** Ligaments joints ko support karte hain. Immobilization mein flexibility badal sakti hai, lekin ligaments turant disappear nahi hote.

**D kyun galat hai:** Regular movement na milne se stiffness badh sakti hai. Unlimited joint mobility expected nahi hai.

**Exam clue:** Fixed posture aur soft tissue shortening ko contracture se jodo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q13. What is a common musculoskeletal consequence of prolonged disuse?

Source bank Q3.

- **A.** Increased muscle mass without activity
- **B.** Permanent improvement in all joint movements
- **C.** Muscle atrophy and reduced strength
- **D.** Increased bone density in every case

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. Muscle atrophy and reduced strength**

**A kyun galat hai:** Muscle ko strength maintain karne ke liye suitable activity aur nutrition chahiye. Disuse se muscle mass apne aap nahi badhta.

**B kyun galat hai:** Joint movement kam hone se stiffness aur contracture ho sakte hain. Har joint ki movement permanently improve nahi hoti.

**C kyun sahi hai:** Jab muscle ka workload kam hota hai, toh protein breakdown aur synthesis ka balance badal sakta hai. Muscle size kam hone ko atrophy kehte hain. Isse strength aur daily activities karne ki ability kam ho sakti hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Bones ko suitable loading se strength maintain karne mein madad milti hai. Prolonged inactivity mein bone mineral loss bhi ho sakta hai.

**Exam clue:** Disuse ka common result muscle atrophy aur weakness hai.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q27. A patient with unilateral leg swelling develops sudden shortness of breath and pleuritic chest pain. Which action has highest priority?

Source bank Q2.

- **A.** Complete the scheduled mobility assessment first
- **B.** Emergency respiratory and circulatory assessment for possible pulmonary embolism
- **C.** Apply a warm compress before checking vital signs
- **D.** Begin routine leg massage

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: B. Emergency respiratory and circulatory assessment for possible pulmonary embolism**

**A kyun galat hai:** Routine mobility assessment baad mein ho sakti hai. Naye chest pain aur dyspnea mein emergency care priority hai.

**B kyun sahi hai:** Leg swelling ke saath achanak breathlessness aur saans lene par chest pain possible pulmonary embolism ke warning signs hain. Deep vein ke clot ka hissa lungs ki artery tak pahunch sakta hai. Nurse turant airway, breathing, circulation aur oxygenation assess karti hai aur emergency help activate karti hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Warm compress acute breathing problem ko treat nahi karta. Nurse ko pehle respiratory aur circulatory stability check karni chahiye.

**D kyun galat hai:** Suspected DVT wale leg ki massage appropriate nahi hai. Isse emergency assessment delay hoti hai aur local tissue unnecessarily manipulate hota hai.

**Exam clue:** Possible PE mein pehle breathing aur circulation assess karo.

### Q42. A patient has been on bed rest for weeks and is beginning rehabilitation. Why should upright activity be progressed gradually?

Source bank Q6.

- **A.** Cardiovascular deconditioning can impair tolerance of sudden standing
- **B.** Gradual progression eliminates all future fall risk
- **C.** Bed rest guarantees improved orthostatic responses
- **D.** Standing always causes permanent paralysis

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: A. Cardiovascular deconditioning can impair tolerance of sudden standing**

**A kyun sahi hai:** Bed rest ke baad cardiovascular system standing ki demand ke liye kam prepared ho sakta hai. Patient uthta hai toh blood legs mein pool ho sakta hai aur BP gir sakta hai. Nurse gradually sitting aur standing progress karti hai, symptoms aur BP check karti hai aur zaroorat par assistance deti hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Gradual activity risk kam kar sakti hai, lekin balance, medicines aur environment ki wajah se falls ka risk reh sakta hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Bed rest se orthostatic tolerance guaranteed improve nahi hoti. Prolonged inactivity standing tolerate karne mein difficulty badha sakti hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Standing apne aap permanent paralysis ka cause nahi hai. Actual neurological condition aur restrictions assess karni chahiye.

**Exam clue:** Bed rest ke baad standing par dizziness ko orthostatic intolerance ka possible sign samjho.

</details>

### Q56. Which complication is associated with reduced deep breathing and secretion clearance during immobility?

Source bank Q7.

- **A.** Atelectasis and retained respiratory secretions
- **B.** Increased swallowing efficiency by definition
- **C.** Permanent elimination of pneumonia risk
- **D.** Increased lung expansion in every case

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: A. Atelectasis and retained respiratory secretions**

**A kyun sahi hai:** Immobile patient shallow breaths le aur effectively cough na kar paaye toh kuch alveoli collapse ho sakte hain. Isko atelectasis kehte hain. Retained secretions infection risk bhi badha sakti hain. Nurse suitable positioning, mobility aur prescribed breathing interventions support karti hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Swallowing airway protection aur neurological function se related hai. Reduced deep breathing se swallowing automatically improve nahi hoti.

**C kyun galat hai:** Secretions retain hone aur ineffective cough se pneumonia ka risk reh sakta hai. Bed rest pneumonia se protection nahi deta.

**D kyun galat hai:** Immobility mein lung expansion hamesha improve nahi hota. Shallow breathing se ventilation kam ho sakti hai.

**Exam clue:** Shallow breathing aur weak secretion clearance ko atelectasis risk se jodo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q91. Which intervention helps preserve muscle function in a stable bedbound patient who can contract muscles but cannot yet walk?

Source bank Q5.

- **A.** Complete avoidance of all muscle contraction
- **B.** Prescribed active or assisted exercises according to restrictions
- **C.** Forceful exercise beyond the prescribed limit
- **D.** Keep joints fixed without reassessment

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: B. Prescribed active or assisted exercises according to restrictions**

**A kyun galat hai:** Har contraction avoid karne se disuse aur weakness badh sakti hai. Patient ko allowed activity ke liye encourage karna chahiye.

**B kyun sahi hai:** Active exercise mein patient khud muscle contract karta hai. Active-assisted exercise mein zaroorat ke hisaab se help milti hai. Stable patient ki remaining ability use karne se strength aur function maintain karne mein madad milti hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Prescribed limit se zyada force lagane par pain, injury ya healing mein problem ho sakti hai. Exercise restrictions ke according honi chahiye.

**D kyun galat hai:** Joint ko bina reassessment fixed rakhne se stiffness aur pressure-related problems badh sakti hain. Kuch injuries mein immobilization zaroori hai, lekin plan clinician decide karta hai.

**Exam clue:** Available strength use karo aur prescribed restrictions respect karo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q114. A patient receiving prescribed compression stockings reports toe numbness and the stockings have rolled into a tight band. What should the nurse do?

Source bank Q8.

- **A.** Roll them tighter to improve support
- **B.** Ignore numbness if the stocking remains on
- **C.** Apply another tight layer over the band
- **D.** Assess distal perfusion and correct the fit according to policy

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Assess distal perfusion and correct the fit according to policy**

**A kyun galat hai:** Rolled stocking ka band local pressure badha raha hai. Aur tight karne se nerve aur circulation par pressure badh sakta hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Toe numbness nerve compression ya impaired perfusion ka warning sign ho sakta hai. Stocking laga rehna safety ka proof nahi hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Doosri tight layer se pressure aur badh sakta hai. Pehle harmful compression remove karna aur assessment zaroori hai.

**D kyun sahi hai:** Nurse problematic stocking ka use rok kar harmful pressure relieve karti hai aur skin colour, temperature, sensation, capillary refill aur pulses assess karti hai. Abnormal findings par prompt clinical review leti hai. Fit aur suitability confirm hone ke baad hi policy ke according use resume karti hai.

**Exam clue:** Compression ke saath numbness ya pain ho toh device rok kar neurovascular assessment karo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q20. Which intervention supports functional independence during rehabilitation?

Source bank Q11.

- **A.** Set achievable goals and assist only as much as necessary for safety
- **B.** Perform every activity for the patient indefinitely
- **C.** Avoid discussing progress with the patient
- **D.** Demand full independence immediately

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: A. Set achievable goals and assist only as much as necessary for safety**

**A kyun sahi hai:** Nurse patient ke saath realistic goal set karti hai, jaise safe assistance se chair tak transfer karna. Patient jitna safely khud kar sake utna karne diya jaata hai. Assistance balance, fatigue aur recovery ke according adjust hoti hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Har activity indefinitely nurse kar de toh patient ko remaining skills practice karne ka mauka nahi milta. Zaroorat se zyada help dependence badha sakti hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Patient ko progress batane aur goals discuss karne se woh rehabilitation mein participate kar sakta hai. Discussion avoid karna person-centred care ko kamzor karta hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Turant full independence force karna falls ya injury ka risk badha sakta hai. Gradual progression aur supervision chahiye.

**Exam clue:** Rehabilitation mein maximum safe participation encourage karo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

### Q30. Which action is appropriate for a patient using an intermittent pneumatic compression device?

Source bank Q9.

- **A.** Assume device use replaces all clinical monitoring
- **B.** Leave it disconnected during all prescribed use
- **C.** Ensure correct fit and function and inspect skin according to the plan
- **D.** Apply it over a painful suspected DVT without assessment

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. Ensure correct fit and function and inspect skin according to the plan**

**A kyun galat hai:** IPC clot risk kam kar sakta hai, lekin skin injury, symptoms aur patient risk monitor karna abhi bhi zaroori hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Disconnected IPC device prescribed pressure cycles deliver nahi karta. Nurse device ki functioning check karti hai.

**C kyun sahi hai:** Intermittent pneumatic compression mein sleeves inflate aur deflate hokar leg veins ka blood flow support karti hain. Nurse indication, contraindications, fit, tubing aur functioning check karti hai aur plan ke according skin inspect karti hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Painful suspected DVT mein naya compression bina assessment start nahi karna chahiye. Nurse symptoms escalate karti hai aur authorized plan follow karti hai.

**Exam clue:** IPC prophylaxis mein correct application aur monitoring dono important hain.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q60. A patient with a recent stroke has neglect of the affected side during grooming. Which approach is appropriate?

Source bank Q12.

- **A.** Assume neglect proves complete blindness
- **B.** Use individualized scanning and safety cues with rehabilitation team guidance
- **C.** Ignore the neglected side during all care
- **D.** Force rapid movements without cues

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: B. Use individualized scanning and safety cues with rehabilitation team guidance**

**A kyun galat hai:** Neglect attention aur spatial awareness ki problem ho sakti hai. Isse complete blindness automatically establish nahi hoti aur vision separately assess hoti hai.

**B kyun sahi hai:** Stroke ke baad spatial neglect mein patient affected side ki stimuli ya body part par attention nahi de paata. Yeh sirf eyesight ki problem nahi hai. Nurse rehabilitation team ke plan ke according scanning cues aur safe grooming practice use karti hai aur injury risk monitor karti hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Neglected side ignore karne se patient us taraf ke objects ya body parts miss kar sakta hai. Isse injury aur self-care difficulty badh sakti hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Rapid movements force karne se confusion aur fall risk badh sakta hai. Individualized cues aur suitable pace zyada useful hain.

**Exam clue:** Neglect aur visual loss ko ek hi condition mat samjho.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q78. A patient with limited mobility and poor intake is developing constipation. Which mechanism contributes?

Source bank Q10.

- **A.** Immobility always increases bowel propulsion
- **B.** Reduced activity and insufficient fluid or fiber can impair bowel function
- **C.** Low fluid intake guarantees soft stool
- **D.** Constipation is unrelated to medication or activity

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: B. Reduced activity and insufficient fluid or fiber can impair bowel function**

**A kyun galat hai:** Immobility har patient mein bowel propulsion nahi badhati. Reduced movement constipation ka contributor ho sakta hai.

**B kyun sahi hai:** Activity kam hone par bowel movement slow ho sakti hai. Insufficient fluid aur fiber se stool pass karna mushkil ho sakta hai. Nurse bowel history, medicines aur diet-fluid restrictions assess karke suitable activity aur bowel plan arrange karti hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Kam fluid intake se stool hard ho sakta hai. Soft stool ki guarantee nahi hoti.

**D kyun galat hai:** Activity, diet aur opioids jaise medicines bowel function affect kar sakte hain. Nurse sab factors assess karti hai.

**Exam clue:** Constipation mein mobility, fluid, fiber aur medicine history saath assess karo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q4. A patient with new lower-limb weakness is being assessed for transfer ability. Which finding is most relevant?

Source bank Q14.

- **A.** Weight-bearing ability, balance, cognition and required assistance
- **B.** Only height
- **C.** Only the patient's diagnosis without functional assessment
- **D.** Only the patient's preferred shoe color

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: A. Weight-bearing ability, balance, cognition and required assistance**

**A kyun sahi hai:** Nurse check karti hai ki patient leg par kitna weight safely bear kar sakta hai, balance maintain kar sakta hai aur instructions samajh sakta hai ya nahi. Assessment aur restrictions se suitable transfer device aur staff assistance decide hoti hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Height equipment size choose karne mein kabhi relevant hai, lekin isse transfer ability akeli establish nahi hoti.

**C kyun galat hai:** Diagnosis background batata hai, lekin same diagnosis wale patients ki functional ability alag ho sakti hai. Actual assessment chahiye.

**D kyun galat hai:** Shoe colour transfer safety ka indicator nahi hai. Footwear ka fit aur slip resistance relevant ho sakte hain.

**Exam clue:** Safe transfer ka decision actual function aur prescribed weight-bearing status par lo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

### Q14. Why is regular skin inspection important under an orthosis or splint?

Source bank Q15.

- **A.** Skin underneath a device cannot become damaged
- **B.** A splint prevents every pressure injury
- **C.** The device can create pressure, friction and moisture-related skin injury
- **D.** Inspection is needed only if the device breaks

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. The device can create pressure, friction and moisture-related skin injury**

**A kyun galat hai:** Skin device ke neeche pressure aur moisture ke contact mein reh sakti hai. Device covered hone se damage impossible nahi hota.

**B kyun galat hai:** Splint alignment maintain karne mein help kar sakta hai, lekin har pressure injury prevent nahi karta. Fit aur skin assessment important hain.

**C kyun sahi hai:** Orthosis ya splint body part ko support karta hai, lekin contact areas mein pressure, friction ya moisture se injury ho sakti hai. Nurse prescribed wearing aur skin-check schedule follow karti hai aur persistent redness, pain ya damage report karti hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Device intact ho tab bhi pressure aur rubbing ho sakti hai. Inspection ko device tootne tak delay nahi karna chahiye.

**Exam clue:** Support device ke contact areas bhi pressure injury risk mein aate hain.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q71. A patient becomes exhausted midway through a rehabilitation session. Which action is appropriate?

Source bank Q16.

- **A.** Increase exercise intensity immediately
- **B.** Assess symptoms and vital status, provide rest and adapt the session
- **C.** Document the session as completed if the patient stopped
- **D.** Insist that the full session must be completed without rest

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: B. Assess symptoms and vital status, provide rest and adapt the session**

**A kyun galat hai:** Exhausted patient mein intensity immediately badhana bina assessment unsafe hai. Pehle cause aur tolerance samajhna zaroori hai.

**B kyun sahi hai:** Exhaustion expected exertion ya new deterioration ka sign ho sakti hai. Nurse session pause karke symptoms, breathing, pulse aur BP jaise findings assess karti hai. Rest deti hai aur red flags par urgent help leti hai. Further activity tolerance aur team plan ke according adjust hoti hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Agar patient session complete nahi kar paaya toh completed record karna inaccurate hai. Actual activity aur symptoms document karne chahiye.

**D kyun galat hai:** Without rest session force karne se fatigue aur deterioration badh sakti hai. Safety target duration se zyada important hai.

**Exam clue:** New exhaustion par pause, assessment aur individualized progression karo.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q110. Which assessment tool focuses on independence in activities such as feeding, bathing, transfers and toileting?

Source bank Q13.

- **A.** Apgar score
- **B.** Glasgow Coma Scale as a complete ADL scale
- **C.** Bishop score
- **D.** Barthel Index

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. Barthel Index**

**A kyun galat hai:** Apgar newborn ki birth ke baad initial condition assess karta hai. Adult daily living independence ke liye yeh scale nahi hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Glasgow Coma Scale eye, verbal aur motor responses se consciousness assess karta hai. Yeh feeding, bathing aur toileting ka complete functional scale nahi hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Bishop score cervix ki readiness for labour induction assess karta hai. Iska rehabilitation independence se sambandh nahi hai.

**D kyun sahi hai:** Barthel Index daily living activities jaise feeding, bathing, toilet use aur transfers mein patient ki independence ya assistance ki need assess karta hai. Same scoring version se serial assessment rehabilitation progress compare karne mein help karta hai.

**Exam clue:** Barthel Index ko ADL aur mobility independence se yaad rakho.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

### Q30. Which finding is an appropriate measurable rehabilitation outcome?

Source bank Q19.

- **A.** The nurse will provide all care forever
- **B.** The patient will become better eventually
- **C.** The patient's diagnosis will disappear immediately
- **D.** The patient transfers from bed to chair with one-person assistance by the planned date

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: D. The patient transfers from bed to chair with one-person assistance by the planned date**

**A kyun galat hai:** Nurse ka indefinitely saari care dena patient ke functional improvement ko measure nahi karta. Goal patient ki ability par focus hona chahiye.

**B kyun galat hai:** Eventually better hone mein specific task, assistance ya time limit clear nahi hai. Progress objectively measure karna mushkil hai.

**C kyun galat hai:** Diagnosis turant disappear hone ki guarantee nahi hoti. Rehabilitation disease cure ke bina bhi daily function improve kar sakti hai.

**D kyun sahi hai:** Bed se chair transfer, one-person assistance aur planned date specify karne se goal observable aur measurable banta hai. Nurse actual performance compare karke rehabilitation plan review kar sakti hai.

**Exam clue:** Measurable goal mein task, assistance level aur timeframe clear rakho.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

### Q42. A patient has new weakness, numbness and pain beneath a limb support device. What is the priority?

Source bank Q18.

- **A.** Wait for the next scheduled device check
- **B.** Apply tighter straps
- **C.** Assess neurovascular function and relieve suspected harmful pressure according to protocol
- **D.** Assume discomfort is necessary for rehabilitation

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. Assess neurovascular function and relieve suspected harmful pressure according to protocol**

**A kyun galat hai:** Next scheduled check ka wait karne se time-sensitive nerve ya vascular compromise miss ho sakta hai. Naye symptoms par turant assessment chahiye.

**B kyun galat hai:** Straps aur tight karne se local pressure aur neurovascular injury badh sakti hai.

**C kyun sahi hai:** New weakness, numbness aur pain nerve ya vessel compression ke warning signs ho sakte hain. Nurse distal circulation, sensation, movement aur pain promptly assess karti hai aur harmful pressure protocol ke according relieve karti hai. Severe ya persistent symptoms, especially increasing pain, urgent clinical escalation maangte hain.

**D kyun galat hai:** Pain aur numbness ko necessary rehabilitation discomfort maan lena unsafe hai. New neurological signs ko normal soreness se alag assess karo.

**Exam clue:** Device-related new pain, numbness ya weakness urgent neurovascular concern hai.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q81. An older patient with prolonged immobility is preparing for discharge home. Which plan addresses multiple safety risks?

Source bank Q20.

- **A.** Assess home access, caregiver ability, equipment, skin care and mobility follow-up
- **B.** Advise indefinite bed rest without review
- **C.** Provide only a list of exercises without discussing safety
- **D.** Send the patient home without assessing transfer needs

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: A. Assess home access, caregiver ability, equipment, skin care and mobility follow-up**

**A kyun sahi hai:** Discharge se pehle nurse home access, transfer ability, caregiver capacity aur required equipment assess karti hai. Skin protection, safe mobility aur follow-up ka plan patient aur team ke saath banati hai. Isse avoidable injury aur dependence ka risk kam karne mein madad milti hai.

**B kyun galat hai:** Indefinite bed rest se deconditioning, pressure injury aur dependence badh sakte hain. Activity individual restrictions aur follow-up ke according plan honi chahiye.

**C kyun galat hai:** Exercise list useful ho sakti hai, lekin transfers, equipment aur caregiver support ki needs address nahi karti. Practical teaching aur assessment chahiye.

**D kyun galat hai:** Transfer needs assess kiye bina discharge se patient aur caregiver dono ko injury ka risk ho sakta hai. Safe support arrangement pehle verify karo.

**Exam clue:** Discharge mein function, environment, caregiver aur follow-up saath dekho.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>

### Q105. Which intervention helps maintain joint alignment in a patient unable to reposition independently?

Source bank Q17.

- **A.** Avoid all reassessment after applying pillows
- **B.** Place limbs in extreme flexion continuously
- **C.** Use appropriate supports and regular individualized repositioning
- **D.** Use hard objects directly beneath all bony prominences

<details><summary>Answer aur explanation dekho</summary>

**Correct: C. Use appropriate supports and regular individualized repositioning**

**A kyun galat hai:** Pillow lagane ke baad bhi alignment aur skin response badal sakta hai. Nurse reassess karti hai ki support harmful pressure toh nahi bana raha.

**B kyun galat hai:** Continuous extreme flexion se soft tissue shortening aur pressure injury ka risk badh sakta hai. Positioning clinically appropriate honi chahiye.

**C kyun sahi hai:** Suitable pillows ya supports limbs ko proper alignment mein rakhne mein help karte hain. Individualized repositioning sustained pressure aur stiffness ka risk kam kar sakti hai. Nurse condition, skin aur restrictions dekhkar plan adjust karti hai.

**D kyun galat hai:** Bony prominences ke neeche hard objects concentrated pressure create kar sakte hain. Suitable pressure redistribution aur support use karo.

**Exam clue:** Alignment ke saath pressure relief aur regular reassessment zaroori hain.

**Evidence and links:** Preserve current mock metadata and references. Review source-bank evidence for appropriate qualified propagation only after coordination.

</details>
